with ssr as (
    SELECT s_store_id, sum(sales_price) as sales, sum(profit) as profit, sum(return_amt) as returns, sum(net_loss) as profit_loss
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_date BETWEEN '2000-08-19' AND '2000-09-02'
    GROUP BY s_store_id
),
csr as (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_id, sum(sales_price) as sales, sum(profit) as profit, sum(return_amt) as returns, sum(net_loss) as profit_loss
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_date BETWEEN '2000-08-19' AND '2000-09-02'
    GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr as (
    SELECT web_site_id, sum(sales_price) as sales, sum(profit) as profit, sum(return_amt) as returns, sum(net_loss) as profit_loss
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_date BETWEEN '2000-08-19' AND '2000-09-02'
    LEFT OUTER JOIN web_returns ON web_sales.ws_item_sk = web_returns.wr_item_sk AND web_sales.ws_order_number = web_returns.wr_order_number
    GROUP BY web_site_id
)
SELECT channel , id , sum(sales) as sales , sum(returns) as returns , sum(profit) as profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' as channel , 'store' || s_store_id as id , sales , returns , (profit - profit_loss) as profit FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' as channel , 'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id as id , sales , returns , (profit - profit_loss) as profit FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' as channel , 'web_site' || web_site_id as id , sales , returns , (profit - profit_loss) as profit FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel, id)
ORDER BY channel ,id LIMIT 100
